title: Midnight Craving British Wrap
description: A late-night British-inspired wrap to satisfy your cravings, made with savory butter and a hint of midnight magic.
instructions: 1. Preheat a pan over medium heat.
2. Place the British butter in the pan and let it melt.
3. Place the light wrap in the pan and let it cook for 1-2 minutes, until it starts to brown.
4. Add the craving filling (if using) to one half of the wrap.
5. Sprinkle the midnight cheese over the filling.
6. Fold the other half of the wrap over the filling.
7. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the wrap is crispy.
8. Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper (if using).
